arguments.content:
import pandas as pd
import sys

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook("budget.xlsx", data_only=True)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (dims={ws.dimensions}, max_row={ws.max_row}, max_col={ws.max_column}) ===")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        print([c.value for c in row])

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    print(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8"))
